links.outcome: Physician time reading and replying to messages and reply length with vs without GenAI drafts
links.effect: GenAI associated with 21.8% increase in read time (95% CI 5.2% to 41.0%; P=.008), -5.9% reply time (P=.33), 17.9% increase in reply length (P<.001).
links.quote: The estimated association of GenAI was a 21.8% increase in read time (95% CI, 5.2% to 41.0%; P = .008), a -5.9% change in reply time (95% CI, -16.6% to 6.2%; P = .33), and a 17.9% increase in reply length (95% CI, 10.1% to 26.2%; P < .001).

screen.reason: This is a randomized trial assessing the operational impact (time spent, message length) of deploying GenAI-drafted replies in an EHR for primary care physicians compared to usual care without drafts, rather than testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice variation.
